Machine Learning Engineer
Company: Synapse AI is a well-funded AI startup (Series B, 80 employees) building multimodal foundation models for enterprise document understanding, headquartered in San Francisco, CA.

Location: San Francisco, CA (In-office preferred; strong candidates may negotiate hybrid)
Compensation: $175,000 - $225,000 + equity

About the Role:
We are hiring an ML Engineer to join our core model training and serving team. You will work on the full ML lifecycle - from data curation and model training through evaluation, optimization, and production deployment. You will work alongside world-class researchers and have direct impact on the models used by our enterprise customers.

Responsibilities:
- Design and implement training pipelines for large-scale multimodal models using PyTorch and distributed training frameworks
- Build and maintain MLOps infrastructure: experiment tracking, model registry, and deployment pipelines
- Optimize model inference for latency and throughput on GPU clusters using quantization and batching strategies
- Collaborate with research scientists to translate experimental prototypes into production-ready systems
- Write high-quality, well-tested code and contribute to internal ML platform tooling
- Monitor model performance in production and develop automated evaluation and alerting systems

Requirements:
- 3+ years of ML engineering or applied ML research experience (required)
- Strong proficiency in PyTorch, including custom training loops and distributed training (DDP, FSDP) (required)
- Hands-on experience building MLOps pipelines (experiment tracking with MLflow or W&B, model serving) (required)
- Solid software engineering fundamentals: testing, code review, version control (required)
- Experience deploying ML models to production serving infrastructure (required)

Nice to have:
- Familiarity with transformer architectures and attention mechanisms
- Experience with model quantization (INT8, FP16) or distillation
- Knowledge of ONNX, TensorRT, or vLLM for inference optimization
- Exposure to multimodal (vision + language) model training
- Prior publications or contributions to open-source ML projects
